tables.name: fixture_flags
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE fixture_flags(name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: idempotency_keys
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE idempotency_keys(actor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),kind TEXT NOT NULL,client_request_id TEXT NOT NULL,result_id TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(actor_id,kind,client_request_id))

tables.name: messages
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE messages(id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,ticket_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tickets(id),author_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),content TEXT NOT NULL,visibility TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: sessions
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE sessions(token_hash TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),csrf TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at REAL NOT NULL)

tables.name: ticket_events
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE ticket_events(id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,ticket_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tickets(id),event_type TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: tickets
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE tickets(id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),title TEXT NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,priority TEXT NOT NULL,assignee_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id),version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(version)='integer' AND version>=1),created_at TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: users
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE users(id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,email TEXT NOT NULL,email_normalized TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,role TEXT NOT NULL,active INTEGER NOT NULL)
